About Me

I'm Mohamed, a Graphic Designer focused on creating clean, impactful and visually engaging designs. I combine creativity, composition and visual storytelling to turn ideas into strong visual experiences.

My work covers social media designs, branding, logo design, advertising campaigns, posters and promotional visuals. I focus on creating designs that are not only attractive, but also communicate the right message and support the brand's identity.
